notes.title: 9/20/2025 - Encounters/Player QoL! Beatrix's Sweets n Treats!
notes.content:
Hello Riftanians, I know it’s been a extremely long time since I’ve updated anything but now that I’ve gotten a couple steam reviews and I know some of my friends have played the game I wanted to make some changes for QoL!

[u][b]PLAYER QOL:[/b][/u]

- On Mainland areas (The Riftania overworlds, Future Riftania Overworlds, and Elven Lands) I took off Encounters on the pathways, unless there is visible cracks on the pathways than you can still encounter enemies on those tiles

- Added a Minimum Encounter Rate of 20 Steps across the entire game, this should make the travelling aspect way less stressful for the player! (This will count the 20 steps if you take them on the safe path just be mindful)

I apologize for not thinking of this earlier.

- Dungeons have a new passive for you as soon as you walk in: Dungeon Delver: Lure Potion passive effect but also provide a 125% Rift Materia, 5% Gold, and 5% Item Discovery Buff! Also Provides 10% Hit Rate and Higher Chance to gain the upper hand on the first move in Battles!

I realized the Inn costs are quite harsh especially in the beginning of the game when theres so many fights (Hopefully less with the changes)

- Halved Inn Costs up to level 60 Average Party level!

- Whenever a Character levels up, they will now restore Full HP and Mana!

[u][b]Beatrix's Sweets n Treats:[/b][/u]

Added Beatrix's Sweets n Treats to:
- Cradalios Canyon
- Palein Pass
- Pikarian Gorge
- All 3 Clock Towers
- The Elven Lands overworld
and 
- Kal Teht!

(There is an Inn inside The Sweets n Treats!)

This Sweets Shop has Candy clones of Beatrix managing the place and they sell 
- Ice Creams
- Coffees
- Cakes
- Chocolate Turnovers
- Vanilla Creme Puffs
- Strawberry Shortcakes
- Peanut Butter Cookies
- Frostedge Delights!

Theres also a Goodie Bag called Beatrix's Delights that contains 1 of anything from the store!

- Added obtaining a Lore Book inside the 1st Clock Tower, as I'm unsure where I placed the first one

- Added 2 cutscenes in the Riftania Realm to describe a bit more story and also to remind the player of their Quest!


I also wanted to announce I will be putting the Riftania OST on Spotify and all platforms soon!

notes.title: Subclass Finishing Touches & Recruitment Guild Changes 8/27/2024
notes.content:
Hello Riftanians!

Today I have done a very big update to Subclasses!

But first of all I wanted to say I changed the Title Screen to fit the actual Steam pictures I have on the Store! My good friend ShadowDragon made them for me so I cannot thank him enough!

Now to the main updates:

Big change: Elemental enemies no longer absorb their same element, UNLESS a weather effect is in play: If A wind Spirit casts Swift Current, all wind enemies or any Zephyrkin party members will absorb Wind for the duration of the Swift Current!

[u][b]Subclasses:[/b][/u]

EXP gained changed from 25% of total xp gained to 50% this massively upgrades the leveling speed of subclasses, 25% was way too slow!

[u][b]Elemental Kin classes:[/b][/u]

All classes got reworked and have more moves:

Shrouds got moved to level 10 and they add 20% Elemental Damage

18 gives the corresponding elemental buff spell

The elemental Kin classes are masters of the element, so now at 20 they will learn the T2 Spells instead of at 25, the Mage class retains the 25 learning level for the t2 spells available for mage!

stronger single target spells moved to level 25

30 gives the corresponding elemental debuff spell 

The T3 Spells were moved down to level 35 from 50!

T3 physical moves added into the game for level 45 Elemental Kin! Hits 3x on 3 random enemies!

T4 Spells previously only obtainable in the Adventurer's Guild Optional Dungeon, are now available at level 50 of the corresponding elemental class

T4 Physical Moves added to the game!!! Level 60 of the elemental class! Equivalent to T4 Spells, hitting all enemies for 3x hits!

Meaning now if you put the work into being a master of the element, you will be rewarded with an insanely deadly arsenal of skills for your work!



[u][b]Werewolves:[/b][/u]

Added 12 new moves into the game for Werewolf and switched some existing levels around!

Level 16: Kick Fleas - Kicks a swarm of fleas at the target, causing possible Enrage for 3 turns! Damages Mana!

Mana Sapping Claws: Hits target with a 2x claw attack, Intellect against Spirit, can inflict Sap Mana!

Level 32: Protector's Aura - Intimidates enemy party, lowering their Defense Spirit and Resistance by 25%, Buffs your party by 25%!

Level 38: Kick Blighted Fleas - Kicks a deadly swarm of fleas at the target, causing  possible Blight!! Drains HP!

Level 42: Triangular Bite - Deal a series of 3 hits and have the chance to inflict Poison Bleed and Rage per hit! Hurt self for 33% HP.

Level 46: Predator Aura (Previously 32) - Intimidates enemy party, lowering their Attack, Intellect, and Dexterity by 25%, Buffs your party by 25%!

Level 50: Full Moon (Previously 40) - Anyone that is a werewolf class will instantly transform! Immune to Silver ailments for 5 turns!

Level 55: Leeching Saliva - Hits enemy with an initial Leeching Bite! Leaves a deadly saliva that leeches 5% HP and Mana for 4 turns.

Level 60: Blood Moon (Previously 50) - Anyone that is a werewolf class will instantly transform! Immune to Silver for 5 turns! Blood Coat added on top!

Level 62: Kick Flea Swarm: Multi Kick Fleas

Level 65: Mark of the Hunt! - Once the inflicted enemy takes 20% Health in Damage, Heals the Party! Can also be used on a Party Member!

Level 70: Shadow Wolf - Adds multiple chances to hit target for 50% damage of the original attack for 5 turns!

Level 75: Wolf Herd - Calls upon a pack of feral wolves to tear through all enemies, catching them off guard! (Wolf Pack but all)

Level 77: Kick Blight Swarm - Multi Blight Fleas

Level 85: Lycan Terror - Unleash your Lycanthrope Rage! Amount of hits is determined by user's ATK, caps at 15! Heals user!

That was a lot of Werewolf moves!

[u][b]Recruitment Guild:[/b][/u]

The final thing I'd like to mention is the Recruitment Guild has been revamped finally! I wasn't even planning on doing this but it looks nicer and flows smoother now!
Now the front has the elemental altar and the Rift Materia NPCs!

Across from the Recruitment Guild Shop/Casket Trader I added a new NPC that will basically convert any potions you buy from the optional dungeons into the same stack as the main potion, the way RPG Maker works the dungeon shop potions are a different stack and it causes some items to be unusable, well now if you click check items it should replace them seemlessly!

The basement is redacted now but if you happen to be in there after the update just go up the ladders!

I added a new upstairs to the Recruitment Guild which has these features:

Blacksmith area
Alchemy Cauldron
Teleportation Stone Crafter

Skill Book Trader:

This is not like any other trader, but he will trade Magical Spell Books for the equivalent of Physical Skill Books

For instance: 

Tier 2 Tornado = Tier 2 Wind Pierce
Tier 3 Cyclone = Tier 3 Wind Joust
Tier 4 Galeforce Winds =Tier 4 Wind Army

Tier 1 is obtainable from the Random trader or leveling the Kin Class so I did not put the Tier 1s in!

This is to either get the Tier 3 and 4 Physical Skills from leveling the Subclass, or now you can Change your Dungeon Spellbook loots if you desire the Physical equivalent!

Small Updates:

- Fixed some Icons
- Added 6 Iron Ore Rocks to Future Riftania on the overworld, 3 south of Cryptopia and 3 by the Pale Fort!

Thank you so much for your time

- Rift Haven

I was playing earlier yesterday and was thinking to myself how fast Farming is compared to Mining so I wanted to try to speed it up a bit!

The Mining and Farming Skills now show level ups every time! (previously only would show the milestone achievement level ups, because of the achievement menu)

[b][u]Now for a bunch of Quality of life[/u][/b]:

[list]
[*] All werewolf skills are now categorized under Werewolf Skills and should not stray from them now!

[*] 2 werewolf skills are now useable in human form! 👀   Howl and Bloody Bite

[*] Fixed werewolves den exit: now you just have to walk up the ladder and it should exit, instead of having to click the top

[*] Added Werewolf den encounters and ancestral werewolf encounter to Freezing Forest, Palein Pass, and Frosty Glade!

[*] The Mining and Farming Skills now show level ups everytime! (previously only would show the milestone achievement level ups, because of the achievement menu)

[*] Added a new ring: Tin Ring to the Newcomer's Jeweler store in Rifthaven, this gives a low tier option for Dexterity!

[*] Added Hide Armor to Rifthaven blacksmith, a cheaper alternative to leather... (Hide helmet and shield were already here, with Hide Armor referenced in the Leather armor description, but I guess I just never put it in the shop, oops!)

[*] Added Levitate to the moveset of rogue priests and Lash Out to rogue guards
[/list]

[b][u]Here are some fixes[/u][/b]:

[list]
[*] Fixed the Title Screen picture (accidentally had a placeholder image of the example castle I was using)

[*] Slow Fragment renamed to Cold Fragment (Cold used to be called Slow I just overlooked this)

[*] Werewolves previously regenerated 5% SE and 3% Mana per turn, this accounted for outside battle too, now it is only per turn in battle! (Technically a bug, I don't like when Mana can just generate outside of battle, and this is how default RPG Maker works)

[*] Changed some dialogue of King Leif to account for the new story!
[/list]

notes.title: Riftania Title change 8/12/2024
notes.content:
Hello Riftanians,

I am changing the name of my game from "Rift Walker" to "Riftania"

Changes pertaining to the name change:


Once this update comes out with the title change I will likely be raising the price to 12$! I have updated it super far past what it used to be when I first set my price, I hope you all understand!

A BUNCH of dialogue is being changed around as we speak to remove references to Rift Walker

Zeke now goes by many names: Celestial of Riftania, Riftanian Celestial, Rift Celestial, Riftanian Hero/Heroes, Son of Seldarine

Zeke is now a direct son of Seldarine and related to the 3 celestial guardians, the God Dragon, The Godless Dragon, and the Omni Elemental, who were transformed by Seldarine due to a dark forbidden ritual offered by an exiled demon general of Dark Lord Xexul and turned into servants of keeping the balance between Gods and Devils, luckily Zeke survived this!

Changes in Gameplay:

New 3 minute cutscene in beginning

- Exiled Demon Weapons:

Now once you kill Demon General Boon, and his other 2 General Accomplices, they have a guaranteed drop of "Exorcised Flesh", this can now craft 6 new demon killing weapons: The Blade, Scythe, Sceptre, Tome, Bow, and Musket!

These weapons should be dealing around 50%+ more damage to demon enemies (demon enemies now have an invisible Demon category)

If you already killed the Demon General bosses, the new Demonic Altar under Zekes house will search the world for any "Lumps of Exorcised Flesh" that you missed and magically bring them to you!

- Werewolf Class: 
Yup, there's already Vampires, now we have a chance to delve into Werewolves with a ton of new moves!

The quest will be fairly easy nothing too complicated, and the quest rewards the player with 1 Werewolf serum, bringing this to the Elemental Altar can unlock the Werewolf Class, much like the other sub classes!

Requirements: North Palein Continent, some fighting to kill a new boss, afterwards if you want to reliably grind the class for more characters you must have 25 Farming for the Blood and Blight Wolf, or you can grind the Serum in the Deserted Labs, or the randomly encountered new boss!

Moves: 

Level 3: Bloody Bite (Already in game!)
Level 5: Double Claws
Level 8: Frost Bite
Level 8: Howl
Level 12:Poison Bite
Level 15: Shed Coat (Removes all status debuffs and buffs!)
Level 18: Parasitic Bite
Level 20: Steel Coat (Adds a massive Defense Buff to itself)
Level 25: Lunar Gaze: Buffs Dexterity 50% for 4 turns if werewolf!
Level 25: Blood Coat (Adds leech life to attacks)
Level 28: Ancestral Rejuvination (15% HP for 5 turns)
Level 30: Wolf Pack (Bunch of Bite attacks that results in bleeding and Daze)
Level 35: Cursed Gaze: Lowers enemy Mana and SE per turn
Level 40: Ancestral Gaze: Everything on a Werewolf will heal fully for 3 turns
Level 45: Full Moon: Anyone that is a werewolf class will instantly transform! Immune to Silver ailments for 5 turns!
Level 50: Blood Moon: Anyone that is a werewolf class will instantly transform! Immune to Silver for 5 turns! Blood Coat gained as well! 5 Turns!

Full and Blood Moon still dont work for the silver additional damage immunity but I will change that very imminently!

- New City:

Kal Teht, in Pikari Desert on the West coast

Features:

Wandering Merchant static location
Another Farm for Sugar Plums, Wheat, Cows, and Chickens
A dock for your boat but only accessible once you defeat the Desert Tower boss!
Kal Teht Arena: Fight humanoids in combat for Augmentations, Loot Caskets, and Smithing Tools
(more streamlined way to farm Augmentations)
Marketplace with Jeweler, Blacksmith, Bank, General Store

OTHER CHANGES:

Fertilizer added to game, 2 obtainable in Rifthaven Farm, 2 in Kal Teht, and 2 from the Elven Construction Company
Added Levitate to low level Mage, can cause Daze 25%


FILES:

I have even tested that changing the game folder from Rift_Walker to Riftania breaks the game and it seems to not break the game for existing saves!

If you actually have to change the file locations follow below, I am unsure how it works on Steam as this is my first time changing a file folder, but testing it didn't break anything in my test runs!

The only thing I would recommend potentially before updating is going into your steam games -> Rift Walker -> Rift_Walker -> www -> saves

and copy the files inside "saves" somewhere rememberable,

and once the game updates to Riftania, if the saves are missing just drag the old saves you have into the "www" -> "save" folder, if there isnt a "save" folder bc its a fresh download, just add a "save" folder into "www" and add the files


Thank you again so much for everything,

Rift Haven

notes.title: Bad Luck Mitigation 6/11/2024
notes.content:
Hello Riftanians!

Today I bring a big update that is across all Optional dungeons! 

NOT including Magna, Deserted Labs (Subject to change), and fast repeatable optional bosses

Basically when you kill a dungeon boss, at 10,20,30,40 and so on kills up to 100 kill count, the boss will drop a guaranteed unique loot or their elemental tablet (as that is also a unique).

notes.title: 12/9/2023 Hard Mode Rework and Small QoL patch!
notes.content:
Hello Riftanians!

Today I am here with a big rework to how Hard Mode works, as I felt it was just a gold sink for gold that is quite hard to get early game!

Here is what Hard Mode used to be:

- 50% Mana and HP healed at Inns
- Inns don't heal Burn Bleed Poison Petrification Toxic and a few other Debuffs
- Only can save at Inns

Here is the new Hard Mode:

Enemies:

- 15% Increased Item Drop Rate
- 30% Increased Gold Rate
- 50% Increased Rift Materia Rate

- 30% Less EXP
- +6% higher Critical Hit chance and Evasion Rate
- +5% SE Regeneration per turn
- +5% Blind and/or Confuse chance per hit!

Inns:

- Heal full HP and Mana
- Don't heal Burn Bleed Poison Petrification Toxic and a few other Debuffs
- Can only save inside Inns!

Now after that amazing QoL that I think is healthier for the game, on to the other updates!

QoL Changes:

- Rift's Vertex Rifthaven Inn now has a Training Arena that provides 100-250 gold on the fights depending on the option you choose!

- Blacksmith prices lowered for most of the gear found in Rifthaven's Blacksmith shop, the other Blacksmiths also have these weapons and armors!

- Gold formula changed to provide less gold but still good amounts, wanted to fix higher level scaling of the gold formula if you kill low level monsters for example

Bug Fix:

Fixed W key firing a common event that skips paying for Bernard's unlock slot!

I hope everyone is enjoying the game and feel free to message me in the Rift Walker community pages, thanks for your support!

Tonight I added some fixes and an actual update with this one!

[b][u]Scribing:[/u][/b]

After completing the Tower of Arms 4, unlocking Rifthaven Dungeons, and defeating the Sky Watcher for the first time, you may speak to King Leif in his house at Rifthaven to obtain the Attuned Quill!

Using this inside the Key Items page will bring up a new crafting menu, allowing you to create, and upgrade some Scriptures, theres always room for more Scriptures to be added into Scribing, so keep this in mind!

[b][u]New Items:[/u][/b]

- Attuned Quill: Crafting Menu

[b][u]Major game change:[/u][/b]

I felt that restricting the entire Squire Class from wearing an accessory was harsh, so now Bernard himself has a Cursed Ring that is stuck in his Accessory Slot! If you are already past the point of acquiring Bernard, he will automatically acquire this ring upon stepping into the Riftania overworld!

- This ring can be broken for 200,000 Gold after level 30 by visiting the Recruitment Guild!

What this achieves is no longer messing up other characters from wearing rings and accessories while classing/subclassing as squire, and this also means Bernard can finally eventually wear some big stat upgrades!

[u]The little things I fixed are:[/u]

- Added Wind Water Earth Fire Ice and Thunder Magic categories to Mage Class!

notes.title: Quick QoL Patch July 30 2023
notes.content:
With the release of Rift Walker today I would like to bring a quick Quality of Life fix for the controls that was brought to my attention:

- Changed the Controls section inside Options to be functional, allowing players to customize the keyboard however they would like.

- Updated Rabbit Tunnels, adding 2 more exits/entrances.
